LESSON: METALS AND ALLOYS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements, and Compounds
Topic 1.2: Metals and Alloys

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Metals and Alloys. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are alloys important in day-to- day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the physical properties of metals
2. describe the composition of alloys
3. identify the uses of metals and alloys in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the physical properties of metals
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the physical properties of metals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the composition of alloys
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the composition of alloys. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. identify the uses of metals and alloys in day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the uses of metals and alloys in day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Metals and Alloys using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Metals and Alloys in the examples.
2. Explain Metals and Alloys to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Metals and Alloys.
4. Show that you can: describe the physical properties of metals

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Metals and Alloys using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Metals and Alloys important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the composition of common alloys,
2. Discuss the uses of common metals and alloys,
3. Discuss causes, effects, and ways of controlling the rusting of metals,
4. Communication and Collaboration: the learner works with peers to carry out experiments to demonstrate the physical properties of metals.
5. Respect: the learner accommodates others’ opinions during group discussions on the uses of metals and common alloys.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the physical properties of metals
2. describe the composition of alloys
3. identify the uses of metals and alloys in day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
